items.title: The 'crazy idea' that became a world first medical breakthrough
items.description: Travis Reyes survived a horror military aircraft crash but what came after was a two-year battle from doctors across Australia and the US to save his life.

items.title: Albanese readies federal budget to favour gen Z and millennial voters
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is preparing to break an election commitment and overhaul property tax perks in this month's budget, to give younger Australians a "fair crack" at owning their own homes.

items.title: Man accused of murdering parents and brother in ‘grisly’ attack
items.description: A father, mother and brother have died after a family member allegedly assaulted them at a Rosemeadow home in Sydney's south-west.

items.title: Mercury would 'be alive': Shark victim's family welcomes new drone plan
items.description: Mike Psillakis and his twin brother's widow, Maria, join authorities to announce a program that will see surfers become drone pilots.

items.title: Iran ready for 'renewed' hostilities as Trump cools on peace proposal
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he will review a new Iranian peace proposal, but casts doubt over its prospects as he left open the possibility of future attacks on Iran.

items.title: Police charge man with murdering five-year-old Kumanjayi Little Baby in Alice Springs
items.description: NT police charge Jefferson Lewis with murdering the girl, who disappeared from the Old Timers/Ilyperenye town camp last weekend.

items.title: Marshall slams 'unacceptable' Tigers after horror second stanza
items.description: Benji Marshall said he could not recognise his Wests Tigers side after a humiliating second half saw Cronulla dominate at Shark Park, while there were also wins for Newcastle and Penrith on a bumper Sunday of NRL football.

items.title: Live: Suns pegged back after fast start as King flattened in marking contest
items.description: The GWS Giants burst to life after a slow start at Carrara Stadium, as Ben King is left worse for wear after a big marking contest. Follow live.

items.title: Sister of deceased rock climber Angela Ha says the best way to honour her is to 'live life to the fullest'
items.description: Michelle Ha's older sister Angela died after falling from the Organ Pipes while rock climbing at Arapiles in western Victoria last week.

items.title: After Little Baby's death, Canavan demands government stop 'running scared'
items.description: Nationals leader Matthew Canavan says after the death of Kumanjayi Little Baby, the government must "move on" from its defeat at the Voice referendum and re-engage on Indigenous policy debate.

items.title: By-election of no consequence leaves some major party insiders disturbed
items.description: The Nepean by-election proves Victoria's election in November is likely to be tough for the two major parties, Richard Willingham writes.

items.title: Nomadic family says 'dream is more powerful' than surging fuel prices
items.description: While many Australians are thinking twice about big road trips due to fuel costs, the Sharavnyam family from Mongolia is determined to fulfil a dream to travel the world.

items.title: A year after the landslide, Albanese faces a harsher reality
items.description: The prime minister's second term is now defined less by what he wants to do than by what unforeseen events will allow.

items.title: Military plane makes emergency landing at outback airport
items.description: The C-27J Spartan aircraft took off from Darwin, and the ABC understood it was heading towards Brisbane and near Longreach when personnel observed "signs of smoke" onboard.

items.title: Love story: An accident changed their lives but strengthened their bond
items.description: The goalposts moved dramatically on Beau and Lucy Vernon's life plans, but it brought them closer together.

items.title: A 17-year-old Go-Betweens song inspired Robert Forster's debut novel
items.description: The Go-Betweens frontman spent years developing the story, which follows a pair of musicians on the run from the law as they try to clear their names.

items.title: 'Soundtrack to Australia': ARIA reveals six 2026 Hall of Fame inductees
items.description: For the first time in more than a decade, multiple artists are being inducted into the ARIA Hall of Fame.

items.title: What this truck full of fibreglass sheets tells us about building price pressures
items.description: On Australia's busiest freight route, it takes four shots of coffee, $2,553 of fuel and a little hair metal to keep the wheels of the economy turning.

items.title: The cafe meeting, the $2m bounty and the botched hit that shocked Sydney
items.description: As the house of Hamzy began to fall one of its senior members hatched a million-dollar plan to take out rivals in revenge. What followed has been a secret for five years.

items.title: Firefighters who died battling blaze, from cancer added to honour roll
items.description: Hundreds of people have honoured the families and legacies of Western Australia's fallen firefighters at a memorial service in Kings Park on Sunday.

items.title: 'If the cops came, you'd slip out the back': The shifting role of Aussie pubs
items.description: From a tiny Riverina pub to a polished inner-city institution, Australia's local pubs are changing hands at record pace. As big money pours in, what happens to the communities that built them?

items.title: 'Inhumane': Mick's disgust at cops' justification over the tasering of his 95yo mum
items.description: In an in-depth interview ahead of the inquest into his mother Clare Nowland's nursing home death, Mick says the family wants changes that will prevent another tragedy.

items.title: 'I made the choice': Why James Valentine resolved to die on his own terms
items.description: Broadcaster James Valentine was offered two different treatments for his cancer, so he chose the one that let him keep doing what he loved. Australian Story followed Valentine over his final 12 months as he faced the end with courage, purpose and humour.

items.title: Government announces program to unlock land for oil infrastructure
items.description: The state government has announced the Accelerating Fuel Infrastructure Program, which it says is intended to ease fuel costs and protect against future price shocks.

items.title: Aussies put Olympic heartbreak to bed with historic world title
items.description: Australia, despite not having a dedicated curling facility, has claimed a first ever world championship title, with Tahli Gill and Dean Hewitt victorious in Switzerland overnight.
